summary.text: Mary Fitzgerald is a Republican state representative from District 31 who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mary Fitzgerald's career experience includes working as an accountant, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a fourth-generation South Dakotan, was born in Vermillion and raised on the family farm, and earned a Bachelor of Science degree in accounting and business administration.
She has been associated with the Daughters of the American Revolution and has served as chair of the Lawrence County Republican Party.
Fitzgerald assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 12, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session, she serves on the House Judiciary Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
